mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and business investment are expected to rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month, it indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure during a tightening monetary cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase is not statistically significant in predicting negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3% in the most recent month, it signals a recessionary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic pessimism sets in.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint interaction of GDPC1 decline and UNRATE increase is not statistically significant in predicting negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).
